verdict_note: How the release gate reads this leg (full_parity_gate._committed_verdict): a live GAP reproduces this record and is gate-passing, a live FAIL is excused by nothing. The per-record verdict below is tap_gate.py raw output on the recording run, scored against fp32, and device_floor.py never reads it.
note: One record per Tensix compute grid. scripts/af2_port/device_floor.py scores a live report against the record with the same compute_grid and FAILs when there is none; an unmeasured grid is not a blessed grid.
why_grid_keyed: With the template pair stack on the host the tap set is grid-invariant (3e4b4900, arms at 11x10 and 10x10 bit-identical). With it on the card it is not: the same p150a board scores 8 failing taps at 13x10 and 13 at 11x10 (77248e1f, which retracts the earlier grid refutation because TT_BIO_FORCE_GRID only shrinks, so a refutation proved from the smaller-grid box tests one direction). release_gate.py:2862 already applies this convention to every size-ladder census.
